Motor neuron disease; defining diaphragmatic paralysis, distal muscle denervation and contractures impair skeletal muscle. Respiratory failure is neuromuscular.
Benign ossifying tumor arising in the choroid of both eyes; ectopic bone does not make this a skeletal disease.
Complex congenital cardiac malformation; pulmonary stenosis involves the cardiac outflow tract. Heterotaxy alone does not establish other organ dysfunction.
Sleep-related respiratory dysfunction; cardiovascular and neurologic sequelae are not universal defining damage and are often separate diseases.
Congenital absence of nasal bones is a skeletal malformation; supplied nasal features do not establish airway dysfunction.
Episodic ataxia with myokymia is neurologic. Vertigo and tinnitus do not establish structural or persistent functional injury of the peripheral vestibular organ.
Premature fusion of multiple cranial sutures; neurologic or ocular damage is not established for this nonsyndromic concept.
Meckel syndrome has cystic kidneys, CNS malformations and hepatic ductal-plate disease; microphthalmia 3/3. Polydactyly and cleft palate omitted by cap.
Short stature with delayed bone age, microcephaly and pubertal delay define the syndrome; hypermetropia 2/2 supports ocular involvement. Nail hypoplasia omitted by cap.
Nonsyndromic malformation of digits with syndactyly, polydactyly and abnormal phalanges/metacarpals.
Craniofacial dysostosis, tongue/oral defects and airway hypoplasia define disease; cognitive impairment 80–99%. Optic disc coloboma 30–79% omitted by cap.
Isolated inherited cardiomyopathy with ventricular noncompaction and myocardial dysfunction.
Mast-cell-mediated inducible urticaria defines the skin disease; transient wheals do not establish damage to additional organs.
Acute myeloid malignancy of hematopoietic cells; the translocation does not establish additional organ involvement.
Basidiobolus infection predominantly affects skin and subcutis; gastrointestinal and systemic disease are less common forms across the umbrella.
Central congenital hypothyroidism with pituitary hormone abnormalities and delayed puberty; no common direct damage to another axis established.
FGFR1-rearranged hematopoietic malignancy; lymphoblastic lymphoma is a common defining presentation, supporting the lymphoma mechanism axis.
Oligodontia affects teeth in 15/15; sparse scalp hair and absent eyebrows each occur in 3/5. Cancer predisposition alone does not establish additional organ damage.
Dermatophyte infection of groin and perianal skin; perianal skin involvement does not imply anorectal mucosal disease.
Developmental and epileptic encephalopathy; optic atrophy occurs in 2/4. Feeding difficulty and hypotonia alone do not establish gastrointestinal or muscle damage.
Congenital anorectal agenesis, atresia or stenosis; optional urinary fistulas and urinary symptoms do not establish common intrinsic urinary tract damage.
Tumor originates in endocrine pancreatic beta cells. Hypoglycemic neurologic episodes do not establish lasting brain injury; other endocrine tumors are separate diseases.
Well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor arising in the stomach; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine gland disease.
Enzyme-deficiency metabolic disorder; progressive encephalopathy 80–99%, optic nerve hypoplasia and patent ductus each 1/3 in small series. Reflux is separately coded.
